title: Ethiopian hospitality experiences
competency: Describe traditional Ethiopian ways of welcoming guests.

keywords.def: Welcoming and caring for guests warmly and respectfully.

en.text: Most Ethiopians are welcoming, friendly, generous and respectful. They value warm greetings, handshakes, smiles and respect. They offer guests the best they can afford, often do not sit before their guests, and hold the coffee ceremony to gather with relatives, neighbours and visitors; tea is offered if coffee is declined. Asking about work, life and family is a common way to start a conversation.

screens.title: No coffee?
screens.ask: A guest politely says "no, thank you" to coffee. What will an Ethiopian host most likely offer?
screens.after: The book says that if coffee is politely declined, tea will most likely be served.

screens.title: Welcoming guests in Ethiopia
paras: Ethiopians appreciate warm greetings, handshakes, smiles and a show of respect.
They offer the best they can afford and give priority to their guest; many will not sit before their guests.
The coffee ceremony is a core cultural custom for gathering with relatives, neighbours and visitors.
Common greetings ask about health, work and family: "How are you? How is your family?"
Ethiopians value being polite, modest and respectful.

screens.title: Key words
defs: Welcoming and caring for guests warmly and respectfully.

screens.text: Which are traditional Ethiopian ways of welcoming a guest?
pool: Offering the best seat and food
a: Offering the best seat and food

screens.text: An Ethiopian host who stays standing until the guest sits is being unfriendly.
screens.why: It is a sign of respect.

screens.text: Why is the coffee ceremony held daily in many homes?
opts: To get together with relatives, neighbours and visitors
screens.ans: To get together with relatives, neighbours and visitors

screens.text: How can a hotel receptionist use Ethiopian hospitality at work?
opts: Greet warmly, smile, show respect and give the guest priority
Ask guests to wait without greeting
screens.ans: Greet warmly, smile, show respect and give the guest priority
screens.why: The same values (warm greetings, respect, giving priority to guests) match a receptionist's customer service and body-language skills.
